question: What did you get away with in school that you still cannot believe worked?
story: I convinced my entire high school that I had a twin brother, and he was completely made up. It started as an excuse. I skipped a test, and when the teacher saw me at the mall that afternoon, I said, oh, that was my twin, Marcus. She believed me. So Marcus was born. Whenever I got in trouble, Marcus did it. Whenever I skipped homework, Marcus distracted me. Teachers started asking why Marcus never enrolled. I said he was homeschooled for anxiety. They respected his privacy. A girl asked Marcus to prom through me. I had to tell her he moved to Canada. People threw him a going-away card. I still have it. It says, we will miss you Marcus. At graduation a teacher pulled me aside and said, tell Marcus we are proud of him. I said I would. I never did. He is out there somewhere.
